skill.name: when-reviewing-github-pr-use-github-code-review
skill.description: Coordinates multi-agent GitHub pull request reviews across security, performance, code quality, testing, and documentation, then produces merge guidance and fix suggestions.
skill.summary: Coordinate structured multi-agent GitHub pull request reviews with merge readiness guidance.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: All 46 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and fenced code blocks, not Ruby shell execution. Manual review found separate security risks in the workflow: untrusted relative script execution, unpinned npx package execution, and GitHub state mutation without a confirmation gate. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Relative shell scripts can execute code from an untrusted reviewed repository.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle required scripts inside the skill package and call them by resolved trusted paths, or require explicit user confirmation before any bash execution.

remediation.issue: npx commands use the mutable claude-flow@alpha package tag.
remediation.suggestion: Pin claude-flow to an exact version and document the package source before allowing command execution.

remediation.issue: The workflow can post reviews, comments, labels, and subscriptions without a human approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Default to local report generation and require confirmation before any GitHub API write action.

remediation.issue: Referenced scripts and reference documents are not present in the skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Include the referenced files or revise the workflow so missing resources cannot be confused with repository-controlled files.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Relative Script Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells agents to run bash commands against relative paths such as scripts/github-api.sh during PR review. For external contributor reviews, those paths can resolve inside an untrusted repository and execute attacker-controlled code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented workflow directly invokes bash scripts by relative path while the skill is intended for internal and external PRs. This creates a clear arbitrary code execution path if the reviewed repository supplies those scripts.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Alpha Package Execution
semantic_findings.description: The workflow runs npx claude-flow@alpha from shell examples. The alpha tag is mutable, so installs can execute changed package code without a pinned version or integrity check.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The npx commands are explicit and use the mutable alpha dist tag. Legitimate use is possible, but the supply-chain risk is strong without pinning or confirmation.

semantic_findings.title: GitHub State Changes Without Confirmation Gate
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs agents to post reviews, inline comments, labels, and subscriptions through GitHub tools. It does not require human confirmation before mutating pull request state.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The GitHub mutation steps are explicit and include review events, comments, labels, and subscriptions. The risk depends on available credentials, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Review GitHub Pull Requests With Agent Teams
content.value_statement: Manual PR review is slow when security, performance, tests, and documentation all need attention. This skill coordinates specialized Claude, Codex, or Claude Code agents to produce structured merge guidance.
actual_capabilities: Defines a five-agent mesh workflow for GitHub pull request review.
Assigns security, performance, quality, testing, and documentation review roles.
Explains how to collect PR context and share findings between agents.
Provides weighted merge readiness scoring across review categories.
Defines report sections, action items, and fix suggestion workflow.
Describes GitHub feedback steps for reviews, inline comments, labels, and monitoring.
limitations: It depends on Claude Flow and Flow-Nexus tools that may not be installed.
It references scripts and reference files that are not included in this package.
Shell commands and GitHub write actions require manual trust review before use.
It provides a review process, not guaranteed vulnerability detection.

use_cases.title: Pre-Merge Review
use_cases.description: Run a structured review before approving a feature branch for merge.

use_cases.title: Security-Focused PR Audit
use_cases.description: Coordinate security, dependency, and authorization checks for sensitive changes.

use_cases.title: Large Change Triage
use_cases.description: Split a large pull request into focused review areas and summarize blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Pull Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review with local output only.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PR <url> with this skill. Produce a local report covering security, performance, quality, tests, and documentation. Do not post comments.

prompt_templates.title: Review Changed Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for a known file list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill on these changed files: <files>. Identify merge blockers, test gaps, and documentation needs. Return prioritized action items.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Merge Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PR <url> and calculate merge readiness. Explain the score by category. Separate blocking issues from recommended improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Run Gated Multi-Agent Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with explicit safety controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full multi-agent review for PR <url>. Ask before running shell commands or writing to GitHub. Produce the final review draft locally.

output_examples.input: Review a small backend authentication PR.
output_examples.output: The report lists one blocking authorization issue, two test gaps, and a changes requested recommendation.

output_examples.input: Assess merge readiness for a performance refactor.
output_examples.output: The review gives an approved with comments decision, notes improved query behavior, and requests one benchmark update.

output_examples.input: Review documentation and test coverage for a public API change.
output_examples.output: The summary flags missing migration notes, weak edge case tests, and clear action items for maintainers.

best_practices: Confirm repository trust before enabling shell commands or external tools.
Generate a local report first, then post GitHub comments after human review.
Provide project-specific review criteria before using merge readiness scores.
anti_patterns: Running referenced scripts from an untrusted pull request workspace.
Allowing automated approval or label changes without human confirmation.
Treating agent findings as a replacement for required human code owner review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It organizes multi-agent GitHub pull request reviews across security, performance, quality, tests, and documentation.

faq.question: Does it require GitHub credentials?
faq.answer: Credentials are only needed for GitHub API reads or writes. Local report generation can work without write credentials.

faq.question: Can it post review comments automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow describes posting comments, but users should require confirmation before any GitHub write action.

faq.question: Are the referenced scripts included?
faq.answer: No. The package references script and reference files that are not included in the scanned skill directory.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted pull requests?
faq.answer: Use caution. Do not run shell commands from an untrusted repository without inspection and explicit approval.
